lessons.title: Trophic Levels
lessons.subtitle: Trophic Levels
lessons.description: Learn about the levels of a food pyramid and how they depend on each other.
objectives: Identify the trophic levels in a food pyramid.
Describe each trophic level as a level of energy in a food pyramid.
Explain how a change in the number of organisms in one level affects the other levels.

activities.title: Explore
activities.instructions: Click a level of the pyramid to learn about it.

activities.title: Arrange
activities.instructions: Drag each organism to the level of the pyramid where it belongs. Tap an organism to see a hint.
activities.hint: Think about what each organism eats.

activities.title: Ecosystem
activities.instructions: Change how many organisms are in each level (1 to 5), press Play and watch the populations change.

lessons.title: Transfer of Energy
lessons.subtitle: Transfer of Energy
lessons.description: Follow the energy from the sun through the food pyramid.
objectives: Use a food pyramid example to describe how energy moves from one trophic level to the next.
Describe how much energy passes to the next level and where the rest goes.
Explain why there are fewer organisms at the top of the food pyramid.

activities.title: Explore
activities.instructions: Click a level of the pyramid to see how much energy it receives.

activities.title: Arrange Organisms
activities.instructions: Drag each organism to the level where it belongs.
activities.hint: Think about what each organism eats.

activities.title: Arrange Energy
activities.instructions: Drag each energy value to the correct level. About 10% passes to the next level.
activities.hint: Each level gets about one tenth of the level below it.

activities.title: Transfer of Energy
activities.instructions: Watch how energy moves up the pyramid. Press Next to go step by step.
